Aarj: Aarj has the capacity to barge his way into the conversation, true enough, though it seldom happens. He’s a placid, lovely guy who is rarely rude. On the days he does fire and jump in unannounced, however, you’ll discover a funny mother fucker, and definitely someone worth knowing.
Aaron: A conniving little shit that squeals like a piglet if he doesn’t get what he wants. When he loses a game of badminton, for example, he’ll often belt the victor in the face with his racquet.
Abe: Abe is one of the most chilled-out people in the Kingdom. It's either that or he suffers from narcolepsy. You'll never see him at the side of a sporting ground, for instance, screaming red in the face at an umpire who is in charge of a game that his child is playing in.
Abel: Yes, Abel means well, at least we hope he does, but his powers of retaliation know no bounds. And he isn't a fool.
Abraham: A big, tall, black man, who, like a girl called Besa way before him, takes ages to get warmed up and moving. He's worth it though.
Abram: In the words of Yoda, finish what you begin young man. Apply what you have learned. Don't say - do. Etc etc.
Ace: Suuuuuuure, he's an accountant. Nah, he smokes the house down and he spends all his money betting on horses. How's that going for you Hoss?
Achilles: "Achilles, that's enough out of you! Bruno and Hercules are outside already, and if you don't shut up you'll be joining them!"
Adam: Adam is a perfectly weighted chunk of granite that sails through the air in a lovely parabolic arc before making a wonderful ba-doink noise as it enters the water. Adam.
Addison: Nice guy, but don't put him in charge. It's not that he's a dill and it's not that he hates the attention of leadership, but he's just too nice. Sometimes leaders need to be ruthless, and this Addison is not. Confrontation isn't really his deal, and that's okay. We can't all do everything. On the flip side, girls love him because he's got a softer heart than most of the wankers they are surrounded by.
Adem: Adem can be counted on to do what he says and also to solve the problem with a unique and quite lateral solution. He isn't really a class clown.
Aden: As an open and thoughtful individual, Aden deals with responsibility very well and the only real serious trade-off is that, in a million years, he’d never suddenly reappear sleep-walking in the nude at the dying end of a big dinner party, having gone to bed early because he had to work the next morning.
Adi:
The subtle mastermind who trails almost no discernible wake. Within his circle of friends he is adored and famous, outside it no one has ever heard of him. How does he accomplish this? 

Primarily, by keeping his cool, also by keeping his opinions to himself, unless asked and by retaining a calm sense of optimism and adventure.

Constantly thinking and humorous is Adi, but you wouldn’t pick that either, until you meet him.
Adie: An irreverent soul who wants to be where the action is. Whether he turns out to be a tortured artist or not, he is a sensitive, giving guy who has a lot of love for the world.
Adler: Adler likes a his 4-wheel drive cars to be big - the bigger the better - and with big shiny wheels. True, he barely drives anywhere that would get the car dirty, but he loves the idea that one day soon he will. Adler.
Adrian: As a potential control freak, his name is the first thing you say after trying on a pair of shoes that are a size and a half too small. “Oh, ouch!” you yelp as you stand up, “No, their Adrian’s.”
Adrien: Yes, a very female-leaning name which lends itself to a compassionate and friendly man. Deceptively smart and devoid of a stick-your-chest-out macho ego, Adrien operates behind the scenes with such efficiency and nous that he is largely unheard of and/or underrated, which is a pity. Then again, we suggest Adrien enjoys not being in the limelight. Almost certainly, while he is skilled at nearly everything he turns his hand to, he'd make a wonderful counselor/psychologist and his foresight and understanding of others would be largely wasted if he was a carpenter. All that make sense?
Ads: The nickname for many-a-man who understands that life is but a delicious game, and in the paraphrased words of Shakespeare, all you can do is play the best game you can. Amen.
Africa:
Option A:  If he's a black man, and the blacker the better, then his smile will be larger than his face, he carries peace-only in his heart and he has a deep, long laugh that is contagious like the best flu you've ever heard of. He's intelligent and he's prepared to solve problems and not just walk away from them. Most music gets his hips moving involuntarily, whether he is shy or not, and we can only imagine the fun he gets up to in the boudoir. 

Option B:  If he's a white man then the only permissible reason he was named Africa is if he was conceived there. If he was, then he smiles a lot, he has a ton of friends and his calm demeanour is loved by all. If he wasn't then Africa has buffoons for parents, he's covered in tattoos in ways that make his grandparents wince and, like his parents, he unfortunately has the IQ of a dried packet of chicken noodle soup. High probability he’s on welfare.
Ag: An exact male version of his female counterpart, and she’s marvellous.
Agostino: You belligerent bloody galoot! Now just quieten down for a second please Agostino, we’ll get to your opinion in a moment….Like tomorrow.
Agro: Named after a furry puppet, Agro doesn’t have an evil bone in his body and, instead, is impressively quick-witted.
Agron: Agron rides a fucking dragon to work so it makes sense that he’s a bit strange
Aidan: Aidan never weaves a complicated web, at least, not from what we can observe, although most of his thoughts are kept to himself, so perhaps we’ll never know? His only real issue in life is settling on the thing that he loves doing and how he wants to spend his time. This uncertainty is why he looks just a little bit serious. To jolt him out of this, once in a while just give him a playful cheek-grab. That’ll loosen those shoulders up, no worries. (Note: this is a task better undertaken by the women in his life.)
Aiden: The name of an icebreaker ploughing steadily through the frozen waters of the Antarctic. He is safe and ultra-reliable in even the worst weather.
AJ: A.J is an outdoors fellow and he often thinks he should've joined the army. If this is the case then can we suggest not being a machine man for too long. We want you to think for yourself and make your own decisions, brother.
Aktil: Aktil is rather dippy but he's funny.
Al: Al is alert, he’s hardly ever alarmed and, baby-face or not, he might even be a rather relaxed genius....
Alan: The local butcher. (ie. he knows everyone, he’s liked by nearly everyone and he usually answers even the deepest questions with only one sentence.)
Alastair: Alastair feels that he’d be best suited for an amicable coupling with someone who is aesthetically, financially and morally superior.
Albert: A comedic legend that rarely exercises. Having said that, he’s surprisingly quick on his feet, he loves a joke and he’s young at heart.
Alberto: Alberto is the ring leader until the cops turn up and then he's first out the door. Funny guy, though.
Alby: Alby rhymes with “Naah, she’ll be right, and if it breaks, well.....fuck it....it’s not ours anyway.”
Aldo: In order to escape the tax department Aldo joined a circus. And yes, he's a clown.
Alec: A high-powered name on one level but, basically, Alec is too nice to be ruthless and apart from being embarrassed if you ever suggested he should be, he has to carry around the mantle of ‘what might have been’.
Aleron: Too sensitive to work as a labourer on a construction site, Aleron is a modern man who is good on social media and adept with his personal grooming in his nether regions.
Alex: Not a scratch on his female counterpart. The ‘x’ at the end of his name is like a cross road where he stands for most of the time unable to make a decision. (The trade off is that, usually, Alex possesses the highest IQ in the room.)
Alexander: Alexander married his colleague, Lily, and boy don’t they have fun? Fortunately they have no close neighbours. He is very organised and neat and loves his lycra.  No way would he ever be seen in public holding hands with a hippie.
Alexei: Alexei is rather brilliant. He is also a nutter.
Alfie: Yep, both movies were correct, so rather than listen to us for too long, just go and watch those. (…Okay, in a nutshell, Alfie’s niche is to avoid responsibility, have as much fun as he can and to dodge the tax department at all times. Not husband material, ladies.)
Alfonso: An odd one, albeit a nice one. For example, Alfonso will buy a house because he likes the architecture, and he’ll love it forever, even though the Feng Shui is clearly bloody awful and hardly anyone ever visits. He wouldn’t hear a word against his treasure, and why should he? Is he narrow-minded? I suppose it depends on your point of view, but you can’t ever begrudge a passionate human.
Alfred: Alfred is a quiet old man who wears a Panama hat but no one knows that his younger years were spent exploring the rivers of Northern Africa. He has lived quite a remarkable life.
Alfy: There are probably a million irresponsible larrikins in the world and here is another one. The closer to the equator Alfy originates from the more fun he is and, regardless of how much work he doesn't do, he is impossible not to like. Just don't loan him any money.
Ali: Think long hair. Think calm in a crisis (and possibly so calm he’s useless). Think reserved of opinion.
Allan: Publican. (ie. friendly, knows everyone, quick to help and not bad around motors and engines.)
Allen: A very intelligent individual who has patience (he doesn't bother to correct people too often if they misspell his name, for instance), a quietly powerful foresight that he rarely shoves down peoples throats and, overall, his children are polite, friendly and happy.
Alonso: Pizza Maker!!! EVERY ONE loves Alonso!!
Alvin: Alvin was turned into a frog by an evil witch but he’s quite relaxed about it now. He looks like he’s smiling all the time and, like many good frogs, he pisses distilled water, which is great fun at parties. In a nutshell, Alvin takes very little seriously.
Alwyn: The gifted, mysterious and mischievous garden gnome.
Amedeo: Amadeo is a New Guinean Bird of Paradise, with a huge plumage of ornate colourful feathers. He flitters about the jungle canopy, safe from predators below, chirping his way into many-a-maidens’ heart, although he never seems to hang around for too long afterwards. Some creatures are born not to take life’s general irrelevant crap too seriously, and so he doesn’t. Thankfully, Amadeo is also one of these creatures that the universe seems to mysteriously protect. No one knows how or why...
Amos: A short man and an excellent pool player. He loves his mates and he loves pulling-off a dodgy deal, so long as no one is hurt at some point down the track. (I only mention it because the same can't be said for some of the people he hangs around with.)
Anakin: Okay, yes it's true his parents walked down the aisle to the theme from Star Wars, but don't think for a second that this bothers him. Anakin is quick off the mark, and he certainly doesn't have time for boring accountant/government-type people. Indeed, if you're hosting a party that's dying in the arse, you need to get him over quick smart. He might even paint the walls if he dislikes the decor, but fret not. If he says rearrange the furniture you rearrange it. If he says change the music you change it. And if he spies a buffoon in his midst he’ll actively seek to have that person removed from the premises. And if you start to complain then be prepared for him to either ignore you, or simply turn around and walk out the door. It ain't like he hasn’t got another party on somewhere else. Anakin.
Anderson: Anderson is an Academic. No, he wont win a Nobel Prize and people won't know his name, but he will play his part perfectly and with diligence. (Note: At some point in his life he needs to leap from the roof of a house into the pool, on impulse. Or, preferably, from a large vessel that he happens to be sailing on, perhaps in the Adriatic. If he does this early enough, then look out because the gloves will come off!!)
Ando: The Fork Lift who takes his time, and who believes a handshake is as good as a signed contract.
Andre: He speaks Spanish – or at least everyone thinks he does – and girls love him, but for some reason he never seems to look like an ‘Andre’.
Andreas: Andreas approaches the various aspects, tasks and components of his life like a dedicated scientist who leaves nothing to chance. This very driven nature can be painful to deal with, let alone observe, but he has a good heart and he’s probably good at chess.
Andrei: Sure, his methods can be harsh but what can you do? As a Russian mafia boss this is what his life has become. Sadly, he's come to understand the folly of such an existence, but it's too late to get out of it. There's too much invested.
Andrew: For a long time we didn't get it either, up here in the commentary box, because nearly all Andrews are decent people, often wonderful, but it’s a nothing name that doesn’t actually do anything at all. Once upon a time, the best we could have said is that he might be a quiet mystery. At worst, a nothing bit of nothing, but that’s not fair. He has now evolved into a very nice, very straight piece of quality wood. He’s sanded, he’s there on the carpenter’s bench and he’s ready to rumble. So we’ll just sit here until a carpenter shows up, eh? It’d shouldn’t be too long. We hope...
Andries: Backgammon World Champion, unless he’s Argentinian, in which case he saunters from A to B without much movement, and with a quiet look of calm humour on his face, as if he’s just thought of a great dish he’s going to cook tonight.
Andy: Similar to his cousin, above, his name drops away into nowhere right at the end when it needs to fly and he therefore spends a lot of time feeling slightly disappointed. But, he’s not half as bland as he sounds because he is a generous and friendly personality and the only question we have is, can he prevail? Andy, have you got a carpenter ordered, brother?
Anees: "Mmmmmmm, I see," he says, rubbing his chin. Despite being busy, Anees gave your problem three seconds of pure concentrated thought and, bang, here is your solution. Chances are it will be correct, and if you don't like it we suggest not wasting his time again by asking him something else later on. Indeed, waste his time once and you probably won't catch him again anyway.
Aneurin: More stubborn than Leigh (male) and deafer than Reg, Aneurin approaches life like a coal brick.
Angel: Angel is a funny guy who is reliable 47% of the time. He’s also a gambler and a womaniser, but hey, no one’s perfect.
Anglus: The axis of any rotating sphere. Every moon, planet and star has one, and they are constant forces in a silent universe, which means that some are more perfectly hidden than others.
Angus: Devoid of any fanfare, Angus is contented and always well prepared. If you want to fix a situation then get him over immediately. Don’t speak to him unless spoken to, and if he asks you to do something then do it without question. It’ll be the right thing to do and it might very well save your life. (If you are married to one, or intend to, don’t expect him to remember your birthday.)
Anh: His name ends before it begins, which is why he doesn’t have time to say hello. He’ll just jump out in front of you, all smiles, grab you around the shoulders and say, “Quick! Let’s go!”
Anish:
Anish ain’t no sycophant, no sir. He’s the captain of his ship and often the captain of his peers, who he rules with ridiculous ideas and a stupid grin. 
“It’s a tough life,” someone will say.
“Oh no it’s not,” Anish will reply, quickly. “Life is a mystical adventure. Why are you not thinking the same, my friend?”
And if someone wants to wallow then Anish will assist for only so long, because usually he has a scheme going on just around the corner and if he doesn’t move fast the opportunity may pass.
Anish.
Anson: Anson has never publicly displayed affection in his entire life. Anson, my boy, perhaps it's time to go live in Italy for a while?
Ant: One of the more loving, aware and socially active men in the Kingdom. A pacifist, Ant' will do whatever it takes to keep everyone happy and only then will he see to his own needs. He makes a sensational father, an interested work colleague and a funny and faithful friend to have on any level. If anything, his frustrations arise from not having enough time for himself.
Anthony: Anthony hates it when he’s called Tony but it happens so often that he lets it slide, although this does build up a slight, if not general, resentment of the twits that he’s surrounded by. Normally, he holds a Ph.D in either physics, law or some kind of biological science.
Antoine: Antoine drives a 40 tonne truck at a mine-site…(just kidding!) Antoine is a bar of soap (metrosexual city boy) and he smells nice…..well….unless he’s French, in which case he’s a comedian and a fornicator.
Anton: As a mild-mannered physician, his name isn’t short for anything and it isn’t long for anything. Indeed, it’s just right. Anton.
Antonio:
Not quite the head of state, he is the attempted-head-of-the-family, at least he is until his wife chimes in, at which point he capitulates. In short, Antonio looks good and frowns at the right moments, which works as a nice bluff for a while, but he’s full of shit. 
And that’s okay. Remember that some of us have to be.
Antony: The temperamental coffee maker with a Southern European heritage who talks non-stop. He’s rude to most people, he loves to dance close with beautiful women in the same fashion that a large fake Coca-Cola bottle rotates on a milk bar counter, and he loves his own reflection.
Aquila: Aquila loves sashimi and his style in life is reflected by this. He likes things simple and elegant, and easy to understand first time round.
Archer: Archer is successful in business although he does occasionally lack the human touch. All he needs to do, in order to become the perfect human, like most of us, probably, is to go and volunteer in a third world country where the shit has well and truly hit the fan, and where compassion is your only currency. (Good friends with Phillipa, Mitchell and Marius.)
Archibald: Best friends with Phillip/Philip, Archibald knows all the Renaissance masters, he is well-read and he is excellent company at a large and talkative dinner party. But, if the fate of the planet depended on Archibald catching a tennis ball that was thrown reasonably accurately at him from 30 metres away, then the world, I'm afraid, would be in dire straits.
Archie: Pure as the driven snow my arse. Archie is, however, a very canny bookmaker.
Argo: To call Argo a loner is to assume he is only happy in his own company, and this isn’t so. Argo is one of the very few gifted geniuses, and defining genius is effectively an exercise in artistic appreciation. Argo loves people just as he loves life, but he is able to throw his thoughts and imaginings so far from where he stands that not many are able to grasp what he is capable of, or where his mind is. In short, Argo is crystal-pure and unique to the point of distraction.
Ari: His entire name is off the ground like an Osprey at full tilt and this boy, therefore, can do just about anything and make it look pretty easy. In which case, he needs our congratulations.
Arian:
Would you describe Arian as The Flash?

No, you wouldn’t because he tends to take his time.

Would you describe him as something of a using toad?

No, you definitely wouldn’t because he is considerate and thoughtful in most situations.

Is he an artist?

….sometimes.

Is he a macho, obnoxious waste of time?

No, he’s definitely not that. Indeed, his rather quiet nature leads people to believe he is gentle and secretive. 

(Note: He does love his sci-fi.)
Aristotle: Yes, it's true: He HAS made a plaster cast of his own erect phallus, but you've got to appreciate a man who not only does that, but places it fair and square in the middle of the mantelpiece, afterwards. (He encourages guests to rub it for good luck.)
Arjen: Arjen is aloof like a lone lion.
Ark:
Option A: Take a breath, now hold it in. Hold it. Don’t breath, and listen. Listen to the stillness...Can you hear it?
Ark. That’s him - the noise of perfect nothing. No one knows how he does it.

Option B: A terrifying youngster.
Arkaan: Ah, the prodigal son whose ego is clearly never in need of bolstering, no siree. Highly intelligent, Arkaan cruised through school and then through university, and he hasn't been tested properly yet, it seems. The question is, will he cope under pressure? We suspect he not only will, but secretly will have been wishing for this moment his whole life.
Arkie: Maths nerd. If he's a caucasian then only Asian women find him attractive, and vice versa if he's of Asian extraction himself. Strange, eh?
Arlen: No, he's not shy. He's just not wasteful in any way. As a deep-thinker who always, always means well, he speaks his mind and is thoughtful at all times. Had he been born in India he'd be a bloody guru of some sort by now, with a huge long beard and a dot in the middle of his forehead, easily visible to everyone stretched out in front of him in the 150 metre queue of people desperate to touch his feet.
Arlo: Arlo is one of the few men in the Kingdom who actually PREFERS to skinny dip on his own. I've no idea why, although as a hyper-sensitive and rather brilliant artisan I guess it makes sense.
Arlyn: You probably wont seem him for very long, if at all. Arlyn used to work for the CIA smuggling men and weapons across more than one Middle Eastern border. Most of the time his bosses didn’t even know where he was. These days he rarely acts rashly, he is highly intelligent, he is the last person to comment on any particular issue and no way would he be seen partaking in any kind of potentially scandalous act. Oh don’t worry, he’s not a saint, you’ll just never see him enjoy himself properly, that’s all. He’s never that public. So just bare this in mind when you meet him.
Armand: What a brilliant and marvellous lump of melodrama he is. Although he struggles to keep his dick in his pants. I suppose it comes with the territory.
Armin: A mixute of German and South African, Armin was armed for a long time, especially when the marauding locals tried to strorm his compound near Jo'burg. None of them lived for long and, boy, isn't Armin a barrel of laughs nowadays!
Arnold: A rare South American nut that is very hard, albeit delicious. It’s so hard in fact, that if you dropped it from the top of a very tall building onto a bitumen road, it wouldn’t register that anything has actually happened to it. (Closely related to Wendell.)
Aron: Where as Aaron might be a conniving little shit, Aron is far more forgiving, and happier, actually. The lack of double A at the start means he doesn’t kill anyone in front of him, but he’s still a sneaky little prick - a buck here, a peak up a skirt there, an extra chocolate shoved down the trousers somewhere else - you name it. Aron can garner all that he needs and without anyone knowing about it and he’s therefore skilled at guerrilla warfare.
Art: Yes, by default he possesses the temperament of an artist, but he is also The Quiet and Remarkable Achiever.
Arthur: You might think he’s a dour old man, but he is, in fact, a funny bastard who has lost his keys. He knew he put them down somewhere but for life of him he doesn’t remember where. And he’s late. Naturally, he talks to himself while he searches in the hope that some Lost Key God will find humour in his search and thus show him where they are. This is Arthur’s lot.
Arturo: Arturo looks like a serious man but don’t be deceived. Having said that, he wastes no time talking to people whom he believes have no spine and he has multiple career changes each year. In fact, like Kenny, no one really knows what Arturo does with his days. When he marries he doesn’t get divorced (theoretically).
Ash: Ash is beautiful, flexible and contented like one of those monster trees that live in The Valley of the Giants, in Western Australia, or perhaps Northern California.
Asher: Now Asher, there's only one person who stands between you and untold greatness. Do you know who that might be?...
Ashley: A good-looking smart arse. He and Dean are as thick as thieves, and they occasionally are.
Ashton: The Flat Football. All he needs therefore is a powerful partner to pump him up and get him out the door.
Asif: Asif endeavours to plan most things meticulously.
Aston: Proof that variety is the spice of life, if all of us abhored physical labour as much as Aston then nothing would get built, not a single hole would be dug and barely any beer would be drunk in far-flung pubs out there on the desert edge after a hard day’s work. (Note: Single-handedly he keeps at least three male hair product companies in business.)
Athol: Tell me he’s a comedian? If he isn’t he should be. Someone this funny needs to make some money out of it, surely.
Atticus:
There's always that question in sport: What's better, a team of champions or a champion team?
The team of champions is great to watch, but they lack the discipline to work for each other. So, of course you’d prefer a champion team.
Atticus, despite his rather irreverent appearance and the girth of his ego, is the name of a such a group.
Attiq:
No, he doesn't spend hours and days cooped up in one, like a long-lost painting. Attiq is 'at it' and into life. After people meet him they develop that look on their face which says, "Oh right! That's an unusual name, but what a lovely, present and centred individual!", by which time they immediately feel slightly better about life and themselves.

All problems are solvable, and all dilemmas lead to moments of great learning: this is what Attiq has  been brought here to tell us. Don't sit around and complain. Pinpoint your weakest areas or greatest fears, then go do something about it. Amen, young Attiq.
Aubrey: Aubrey got whacked in the nuts playing either cricket or baseball as a kid and gave up sport immediately. Today he designs tax breaks for corporations and hangs out with Christian, Jonathon and Benjamin.
Aurelian: The flamboyant crepe maker who rarely spends a night in.
Aussie: A Kiwi. Except he moves like a Sloth and ingests way too many substances.
Austen: Highly intelligent, cheeky after the curtain drops and always scoping out interesting people and situations, Austen would make a splendid rat. Now, don’t freak out, we don’t mean that in a bad way at all. Austen is skilled and he’s busy, so give him any kind of unsolvable dilemma and watch him go. (The only thing you’ll never see Austen do is boast about his achievements.)
Austin: Austin is the name of a fat gold ring that’s worn on the pinkie of a fat man who is middle aged, wealthy, and in the process of discovering his homosexuality.
Avern: Intelligent, patient, thoughtful and rarely prone to displays of outrageous public affection = Chief flying instructor.
Avi: Yes, Avi is avid, naturally. He's also open, and happy, he's business savvy and he's quick to act. True, he's never once received a splinter and he can't hit a tennis ball to save his life but we all have a niche to fill!
Axel:
If he can handle the corporate life and the drudgery of wearing a suit every day he'd make a talented spin-doctor. However, our advice, young Axel, is to ditch that ego, at least for a little while, and select a course that takes you on a different route altogether and away from one that aids in the dumbing-down of the masses. Money ain't everything so perhaps you should work for the other team? Do some good: this is the message today.

(And yes, you're still allowed a stack of fun.)
Axton: Does he think things through properly? Has he ever? Mmmm, it's a good question. I suppose you can't blame him. If he believes in only this second and has difficulty seeing the future - and let's face it, he's not on his own - then maybe that's his lot. In a politically correct world, perhaps we need a few more Axton-Bulls to run at the gate and shake things up a bit?
Ayden:
He's about as close as any man can get to being The Invisible Man. People meet him at parties, chat to him for ages and enjoy the whole conversation and then, two days later during a discussion about the aforementioned gathering, those same people will be surprised to hear that Ayden was there.
How this happens we’re not sure. Ayden looks after himself and expects others to do the same, but he keeps it all very low-key. He's a nice fellow and this is just how it is.
Aydon:
On his gravestone they will write:

Not only did he go under the radar 
He built the radar.
Ayman: If there is such a thing as the middle of the road, then Ayman is the machine that spits out the dotted white line. As we keep saying, we all have a niche to fill.
Ayrton: The young folk of today just don't know the value of a hard days' work, do they.
